title: Reefer Cargo Services: what can still be recorded after a service file is closed
content:
## Scope

This quick reference of **Reefer Cargo Services** covers the closure of a reefer service file after delivery and what may still be recorded against a closed service.

## Rule

1. A delivered service is closed **by the system**. The service moves from delivered to closed; it is not a step taken on the customer's instruction.
2. After closure the following may still be recorded against the service:
   - payments;
   - goodwill waivers of fees **already booked**;
   - excursion credits **inside the report window**.

## Quick reference

| Item after closure | May still be recorded? | Qualifier stated by the rule |
|---|---|---|
| Payment (remittance) | Yes | None stated here |
| Goodwill waiver | Yes | Only of a fee already booked |
| Excursion credit | Yes | Only inside the report window |

## Basis Q&A

**A customer asks whether it is too late to pay because the file shows as closed.** No. Payments may still be recorded against a closed service.

**The file closed last week and the customer now asks for goodwill on a setting change fee booked before closure.** Closure itself does not prevent it: a goodwill waiver of a fee already booked may still be recorded against a closed service.

**Can the desk close a delivered service early at the customer's request?** Closure is performed by the system.
